title: Transferring supremum-norm rates and weak convergence of covariance kernel estimators to functional principal components
summary: We show that $L_2$-perturbation theory can be used to transfer rates of convergence in the supremum norm as well as weak convergence in the space of continuous functions from covariance kernel estimators to the associated functional principle components (FPCs). As an application we obtain optimal rates of convergence in sup-norm, including minimax-lower bounds, as well as asymptotic normality for estimating the FPCs in a discrete observational model with errors under fixed, synchronous design.
